select jsonb_pretty(
  explain_filter_to_json('explain (analyze, verbose, buffers, format json)
                         select * from tenk1 order by tenthous')
  -- remove "Workers" node of the Seq Scan plan node
  #- '{0,Plan,Plans,0,Plans,0,Workers}'
  -- remove "Workers" node of the Sort plan node
  #- '{0,Plan,Plans,0,Workers}'
  -- Also remove its sort-type fields, as those aren't 100% stable
  #- '{0,Plan,Plans,0,Sort Method}'
  #- '{0,Plan,Plans,0,Sort Space Type}'
)

SELECT jsonb_pretty((((explain_filter_to_json('explain (analyze, verbose, buffers, format json)
                         select * from tenk1 order by tenthous') #- '{0,Plan,Plans,0,Plans,0,Workers}') #- '{0,Plan,Plans,0,Workers}') #- '{0,Plan,Plans,0,Sort Method}') #- '{0,Plan,Plans,0,Sort Space Type}');
